fields.title: agent: print mode hangs after subagent completes
fields.description: After fixing auth/stale ctx, one-shot pi print mode exits cleanly for a simple prompt, but can hang after spawning a smart subagent even after the model reports the subagent responded. Repro: pi --provider moonshot --model kimi-for-coding -p "it's a harness test. say hi to smart agent and tell me if he reponded". Suspect AgentWorker/AgentManager fibers or child AgentSession subscriptions remain live and keep the process open. Need reproduce with timeout, identify open fiber/session cleanup path, add regression, verify exact CLI command exits 0, run extensions/tau gate.
